The '''Republic Mining Camp''' was a settlement used by the mining workers employed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Located west of the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]], the camp came under attack by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]] during the [[Quesh war]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Mining Camp appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
